svg.title: Language Perspective: Auditable LLM Routing
svg.desc: An editorial figure showing prompts routed across a small panel of models into a certificate, with deterministic labels for prompt features, the feasible panel, ambiguity-driven deferral, and the auditable certificate.
svg.text: An LLM router trading cost and quality at fixed λ — no judge model.

g.text: A deterministic router, not a learned gate.

svg.text: Adequacy should be measured, not asserted.
